truncated.description: True when the tree is incomplete: the walk reached limit_items with entries left, or it omitted an entry it cannot name, as since 0.10.0. The x-b10x-omitted-entries response header tells the two apart: true without the header means the limit only (ADR 0043).

x-b10x-omitted-entries.description: Present only when the walked part of the tree holds entries no item lists (a FIFO, socket or device, or a name that is not UTF-8): their count. When the walk reached limit_items with entries left it is a lower bound, because the walk did not reach the rest. Absent means none was omitted in the walked part. Hidden entries a request excludes and a .git entry excluded by policy are not counted (ADR 0043).
